name: Northside Motel - Maelstrom Coding Cave and Ripper Den
description: Apartment World Edit that turns the Northside Apartment into a full Maelstrom Netrunner lair. Adds a High-Tech Low-Life feel to the main living area, modifies the stash room into a fully stocked Ripperdoc room and Scav Den, modifies the area surrounding the apartment including a roof hangout, and adds a new deep-dive mainframe room.
